intro: The Glowing Fruit is an exotic, luminescent specimen found growing amid strange fronds on the boughs of Teldrassil. Its unnatural radiance and bizarre interaction with the World Tree's soil make it an object of urgent botanical study for naturalists.

p: Discovered hanging beneath unusual fronds on Teldrassil, this large, round fruit radiates an unmistakable light. Botanist Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth recognizes it as non-native to the World Tree, speculating its seeds arrived from distant lands across the sea. Whatever its origin, the fruit reacts strangely to the rich, enchanted soil of Teldrassil, demonstrating how vulnerable the nascent world bough is to foreign and unpredictable flora.
